ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity pixels (values > 180) to 35% low-intensity pixels (values < 60) across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white contiguous zones occupy the central regions of both lobes. Low-intensity black contiguous regions form a 20-50 pixel wide boundary along the entire trailing edge and a dense triangular cluster at the central peduncle insertion point. Numerous small, circular low-intensity blobs (rosettes) are scattered within the high-intensity fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an acute interior pixel angle of approximately 38 degrees and a vertical depth of 120 pixels relative to the adjacent lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern across the entire horizontal boundary; pixel amplitudes of variations range from 5 pixels to 35 pixels from the local baseline, forming a jagged, non-linear edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges of the fluke exhibit a convex mathematical curve that tapers and rises slightly as it approaches the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially dense detection of approximately 40+ circular high-contrast pixel rings (dark circles on white background), most concentrated in the upper quadrants of the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of three distinct, vertically-oriented low-intensity linear pixel disruptions on the lower-right lobe, each approximately 60-80 pixels in length.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive presence of circular rosette scars and significant irregular chipping/loss of pixel continuity along the trailing edge peaks consistent with physical contact marks.
